functional_boundaries: This separate menu preview does not launch chess gameplay or campaign content from ../web.
Classic, Local Duel, Chapters and Online Duel each open a mode-specific preview/unavailable dialog. No mode secretly creates, resumes or loads a demo save.
Existing legacy demo-save browser data is left untouched. The old save-creation and resume/load UI has been removed.
The separate web game supports Classic versus AI, local two-player hotseat and one campaign chapter. Online is explicitly unavailable; no backend is implemented here.
Particle quality and ambient motion affect presentation. Volume persists a preference without connected audio.
Home retains the supplied three labels and images, with honest unavailable-state dialogs for profiles, chronicles and the herald feed.
Home, Play, Showcase and Settings are the four top navigation tabs. Home/Play selections and Settings origin are preserved.
Play retains four 197 by 298 pixel cards, 4px gaps and the same artwork order and typography at1280 by720.
Showcase opens an honest information preview without starting a match. Q/E and controller bumpers cycle the four tabs; typing in Settings controls does not switch tabs.
card_copy_intent: Cards identify intended chess modes. Activation dialogs clearly disclose that this standalone menu does not launch gameplay or matchmaking; there is no STORY mode label.
